Presenting the full video for the song "PAD GAYE JI" from the Bollywood movie Akaash Vani. The film is a romantic drama written and directed by Luv Ranjan. The film features Nushrat Bharucha and Kartik Aaryan in the lead role. The song is sung by K.K., Sunidhi Chauhan, Music is by Hitesh Sonik and the lyrics are penned by Luv Ranjan. Enjoy and stay connected with us!!
